title: CKD-detection: detection of chronic kidney disease from routine non-kidney-specific clinical data (NHANES 2011-2018)
description: Analysis code and derived result files for a two-step CKD detection model developed in NHANES 2011-2018 (4 cycles; development 2011-2016, temporal validation 2017-2018) and externally applied to KNHANES 2022-2024. Includes: (i) the frozen model pipeline (race-blind primary specification); (ii) a held-out transport recalibration ladder with an empirical local sample-size rule (scripts/m17_transport_ladder.py); (iii) a one-command full rerun (scripts/rerun_all.py --check; 7 stages, built-in frozen-value self-checks that abort on pipeline drift); (iv) a post-hoc mortality linkage analysis in NHANES 2011-2018 linked mortality file (m16). Reproducibility status: a full rerun reproduces the reported core values exactly (AUC_ext 0.8099; KNHANES 0.7713/0.7791; mortality HR 1.99; delta-C -0.0104; recalibrated ECE 0.0113); three known divergences are documented in REPRODUCE.md. NHANES and KNHANES microdata are not redistributed.
notes: Released together with the manuscript submission. Derived result files only; source microdata must be obtained from CDC/NCHS (NHANES) and KDCA (KNHANES).
